rationale: Configured plan for high-cost claim identification. Use 25% test split per task requirement ('quarter of claims'). Define target as paid_amount > 95th percentile per task specification. Include comprehensive feature set covering claim characteristics (type, codes, place/provider, flags), service details (units, length of stay, admission type), and financial data (billed/allowed amounts), excluding identifiers and target-derived fields to prevent leakage. Train logistic regression plus random forest per task requirement ('logistic regression plus one tree-based model'). Apply standard scaling to optimize logistic regression performance. Include synthetic_data and class_imbalance caveats given 5% positive rate and experimental context; model_limitations caveat for responsible reporting. Enable show_denominators and cite_artifacts to improve transparency and reproducibility.
